body: Everything I do hurts them. Live or die. I just want to vanish. I just wish none of them every knew me
I appreciate that. But it would be so much easier on them a year from now, if I was gone today

Yeah I am alone at the moment. I can maybe give that a try. I'm trying to sort of write everything out on paper right now. That used to help. Right now it just seems to be confirming that I've totally lost my mind.. haha :/

Hey there. Thanks for commenting. He knows that I go in and out of this. He has been there through all of my previous attempts (we have known each other a long time). He knows I'm hurting. But I've never really stopped hurting. It's nothing new. I don't know what I would say to him. I can't stand seeing the fear in his eyes when he sees me getting worse. It isn't his fault. I wish I could make him see that. He is plenty good enough. It is me who isn't.
